note: Discovered by unittest's own loader, so this inventory and the suite that runs are the same enumeration. A test that matches no category rule is refused rather than defaulted, so an uncategorised package fails the build instead of quietly becoming UNIT.
stdout_note: Test outcomes come from the test runner's recorded result, never from words found in stdout. Several negative tests print CONFIGURATION_FAILURE on purpose while passing; a CI job that grepped for it would fail a green suite.
